name: Footman
walk_cue: Right foot stride, passing leg crossover with bob, left foot stride, passing recovery; shield and short sword swing cleanly.
attack_cue: Combat crouch brace, high overhead sword wind-up, wide forward sword slash lunge with bright gold-white arc smear, follow-through recovery.

name: Archer
walk_cue: Nimble scout march holding bow across body: right boot forward, passing stance, left boot forward, passing stance.
attack_cue: Raise wooden bow aiming right, draw bowstring tight with glowing arrow, release arrow forward with bright kinetic streak, follow-through lower bow.

name: Shield Man
walk_cue: Heavy braced march holding large tower shield forward: staggered heavy step, settle, opposite step, brace.
attack_cue: Crouch behind tower shield, pull shield arm back, explosive forward shield bash lunge with crisp impact shock arc, steady tank recovery.

name: Knight
walk_cue: Armored knight march with broadsword and heater shield: right steel greave step, passing bob, left step, passing bob.
attack_cue: Brace steel armor, pull broadsword high over shoulder, heavy downward diagonal cleave with bright golden slash trail, armored recovery stance.

name: Mage
walk_cue: Flowing blue robe stride holding glowing arcane staff: right step, floaty passing stride, left step, passing stride.
attack_cue: Hold arcane staff back gathering blue energy, thrust staff tip upward charging bright orb, fire sparkling blue arcane bolt forward, staff lower recovery.

name: Priest
walk_cue: Dignified robe march carrying golden cross staff: gentle step forward, passing glide, opposite step, recovery; keep outline crisp without gray mist halo.
attack_cue: Clasp free hand near chest, raise golden cross staff high with warm golden radiance, pulse outward healing sunburst wave, serene blessing recovery.

name: Elite Knight
walk_cue: Commanding heavy stride in gilded plate armor and plume helmet: right boot march, settled weight shift, left boot march, recovery.
attack_cue: Heavy two-stance coil holding radiant blade, tower greatsword high above helmet gleaming gold, thunderous downward cleave with radiant gold arc smear, heroic recovery.

name: Elite Mage
walk_cue: Archmage stride gliding in ornate vestments with jeweled staff: step right, robe sway, step left, robe sway.
attack_cue: Gather arcane rings around staff head, lift both hands channeling swirling azure-gold orb, unleash heavy arcane artillery beam forward, composed follow-through.

name: High Priest
walk_cue: Majestic ceremonial walk carrying sun-halo staff: step, glide, step, glide; pure crisp white background with zero smudge halo.
attack_cue: Bow head charging golden chalice/staff, raise staff overhead blooming golden halo light, project sweeping golden sanctuary pulse forward, poised recovery.

name: Riot Trooper
walk_cue: Tactical march in riot helmet holding stun baton and guard pad: right boot forward, passing hop, left boot forward, passing hop.
attack_cue: Adopt baton combat stance, draw electric stun baton back overhead, snappy diagonal baton strike with cyan-white spark arc, tactical guard recovery.

name: Police
walk_cue: Alert tactical patrol stride holding handgun ready forward: right step, passing step, left step, passing step.
attack_cue: Two-handed pistol aim sight, steady aim tension, sharp muzzle flash burst with bright yellow gunshot flare and slight arm recoil, aim recovery.

name: Medic Bot
walk_cue: Compact medical bot scoot/march with glowing cyan cross visor: step/roll right, bounce, step/roll left, bounce.
attack_cue: Deploy chest/arm emitter panels, charge bright green-cyan nanite core, emit crisp glowing green-blue healing pulse ring forward, retract panel recovery.

name: Rifleman
walk_cue: Crouched marksman jog carrying long tactical rifle: right combat boot step, passing, left boot step, passing.
attack_cue: Shoulder rifle leaning forward into scope, brace trigger stance, sharp sniper muzzle flash flare with crisp golden bullet streak, barrel recoil settle.

name: Riot Shield
walk_cue: Heavy armored advance behind ballistics riot shield: stomp forward, shift, opposite stomp, shift.
attack_cue: Hunker completely behind ballistic shield, coil shoulder back, heavy full-body riot shield ram lunge with white kinetic shockwave, lock stance.

name: Grenade Thrower
walk_cue: Grenadier jog holding launcher/grenades steady: energetic step right, passing, step left, passing.
attack_cue: Reach/load explosive canister, rear throwing arm/launcher back tilting torso, whip arm/launcher forward launching glowing grenade/blast flash, balanced landing.

name: Elite Riot
walk_cue: Juggernaut tactical stomp in heavy Aegis exosuit and fortress shield: heavy right stomp, shift, heavy left stomp, shift.
attack_cue: Lock exosuit hydraulic stance, raise energized shock-baton & shield high, slam shock-shield forward unleashing blue electric impact wave, locked recovery.

name: Shotgunner
walk_cue: Aggressive breacher advance gripping tactical pump shotgun: brisk right stride, passing, left stride, passing.
attack_cue: Pump shotgun chamber back stepping into stance, level shotgun barrel straight right, wide explosive orange cone muzzle blast kicking body slightly back, pump recovery.

name: Heavy Gunner
walk_cue: Heavy armored trudge carrying rotary minigun and ammo belt (ensure full armored boots are cleanly visible at bottom): stomp right, shift, stomp left, shift.
attack_cue: Plant wide feet lowering minigun barrels, spin rotary barrel glowing hot, blast intense rapid yellow-white tracer muzzle burst forward leaning against recoil, spin-down stance.

name: Alien Grunt
walk_cue: Fast hunched chitinous dash forward on agile hind legs: low stride right, springy passing crouch, stride left, springy crouch.
attack_cue: Coil low baring claws/fangs, rear both clawed arms back, ferocious forward leap slash with bright magenta-white claw arc trails, skidding landing stance.

name: Plasma Shooter
walk_cue: Skittering bipedal alien stride balancing bio-cannon/appendage: quick right step, crouch bob, quick left step, crouch bob.
attack_cue: Swell glowing bio-plasma sac aiming forward, open/aim bio-muzzle wide, eject bright cyan-lime plasma needle bolt forward, recoil shudder.

name: Alien Guard
walk_cue: Plodding thick-carapace walk using armored forearm plates: heavy right claw step, settle, left claw step, settle.
attack_cue: Hunker chitin shell low like a battering ram, draw heavy armored pincer/forearm back, slam armored carapace forward with purple-white shock impact, brace recovery.

name: Mutated Warrior
walk_cue: Propelled predator stalk swinging twin scythe-blade arms: broad step right, crouch lunge, step left, crouch lunge.
attack_cue: Spread twin bio-blade arms wide crouched low, raise crossed mantis claws high, X-shaped twin rending slash forward with vivid neon-green/magenta slash arcs, predator recovery.

name: Plasma Specialist
walk_cue: Tall sleek alien march with glowing dorsal plasma nodes: lithe stride right, glide, stride left, glide.
attack_cue: Compress crackling violet-cyan plasma sphere between claws, flare dorsal nodes bright neon, hurl concentrated plasma orb forward with bright beam tail, vent steam recovery.

name: Acid Spitter
walk_cue: Clean four-legged green/purple alien bug scuttle with glowing green acid sacs on its back — COMPLETELY REMOVE the white/green spit mist cloud in front of its mouth in all 4 walk frames, and draw all 4 full insectoid legs & feet completely uncropped: alternate leg crawl, compress, opposite leg crawl, extend.
attack_cue: Frame 5: crouch chest bracing all 4 legs cleanly with mouth closed (no mist); Frame 6: rear head back opening jaws wide as back sacs glow bright lime-green; Frame 7: snap head forward spraying a crisp bright toxic-green acid jet arc to the right; Frame 8: snap jaws shut recovering steady stance with no lingering mist.

name: Alien Juggernaut
walk_cue: Earth-shaking apex titan stomp with massive spiked forearms: colossal right footfall, lumbering weight shift, left footfall, lumbering shift.
attack_cue: Draw titanic fist/blade up roaring open jaws, lift dual armored fists overhead, crash both giant arms downward smashing forward with crimson-purple shockwave arc, rising roar.

name: Plasma Overlord
walk_cue: Imposing alien artillery walk (floating/striding cleanly on base limbs) glowing bio-core: slow menacing stride right, pulse, stride left, pulse.
attack_cue: Open chest/dorsal plasma vents wide, supercharge blinding magenta-cyan energy core, unleash heavy plasma artillery surge beam forward, overheated vent cooldown.

name: Hive Commander
walk_cue: Regal alien broodlord march with raised command crest and spiked limbs: confident right stride, poise, left stride, poise.
attack_cue: Expand crest fins shrieking command roar, summon swirling purple pheromone/plasma bolt from raised claw, lash forward firing bio-lance & command pulse ring, triumphant posture.

name: Imp
walk_cue: Mischievous frantic dash leaning far forward with wicked grin & tail bobbing: fast right hop-step, nimble mid-air skip, left hop-step, skip.
attack_cue: Coil close to ground grinning fiercely, pull fiery clawed arm back spinning tail, lunge claw slash forward with orange-red flame swipe trail, nimble rebound stance.

name: Hell Hound
walk_cue: Four-legged demonic hound gallop with horned head, glowing ember eyes, and crisp solid dark-red/black fur body (full four legs clearly drawn, zero fading white belly): extended bound, gathered tuck, push-off stride, leap bound.
attack_cue: Crouch low on hind haunches snarling jaws open, coil chest back teeth bared, ferocious lunging bite forward with fiery orange fang slash effect, tense landing snarl.

name: Demon Soldier
walk_cue: Steady heavy demon infantry march gripping jagged cleaver/sword: right cloven boot stride, bob, left stride, bob.
attack_cue: Brace broad demonic shoulders, raise jagged iron blade high behind horns, brutal downward chop forward with fiery red-gold slash arc, heavy follow-through.

name: Blood Knight
walk_cue: Sinister crimson-armored knight stride wielding cursed blade and shield: armored right step, cape/plate shift, left step, shift.
attack_cue: Channel crimson aura down blade pulling sword across torso, whip cursed blade into high sweeping posture, ferocious crimson-red vampire slash crescent forward, regal guard recovery.

name: Flame Caster
walk_cue: Hunched cultist sorcerer march carrying burning ember staff/hands: right robe step, glide, left robe step, glide.
attack_cue: Conjure swirling orange fireball between palms, lean back winding blazing fireball high, hurl roaring molten fireball projectile forward with flame trail, ember scatter recovery.

name: Soul Reaper
walk_cue: Gliding hooded demon reaper stride dragging wicked curved scythe: ghostly right step, lean, left step, lean.
attack_cue: Slide hands up scythe shaft crouching low, swing cursed scythe in wide arc behind back, wide horizontal reaping slash forward with glowing crimson-purple crescent trail, sinister spin recovery.

name: Demon Brute
walk_cue: Massive horned brute stomp wielding colossal war-weapon/fists: earth-heavy right foot stomp, shoulder roll, left foot stomp, roll.
attack_cue: Plant colossal feet bellowing upward, hoist massive weapon/fists sky-high, crushing overhead slam forward erupting magma-orange shock arc, heavy heave recovery.

name: Infernal Archmage
walk_cue: Hovering/striding hellfire archmage surrounded by crisp flame runes (solid white background outside outlines): glide right step, bob, left step, bob.
attack_cue: Spread clawed hands igniting twin infernal runes, raise flaming staff/sigil overhead summoning meteor spark, unleash huge blazing hellfire burst beam forward, smoldering poise.

name: Demon Lord
walk_cue: Lordly horned overlord march in jagged volcanic armor (ensure full armored legs & boots cleanly visible at bottom): commanding right step, chest swell, left step, chest swell.
attack_cue: Draw flaming abyssal greatsword back glowing crimson, swing towering greatsword overhead, sweeping cataclysmic flame-red slash cleave forward, domineering recovery stance.

name: Shadowling
walk_cue: Low agile ninja-like shadow dash forward with glowing eyes & shadow blades: quick forward right step, low crouch glide, left step, low glide.
attack_cue: Drop low vanishing into shadow coil, whip dual dark daggers behind shoulder, blinking dash-slash forward leaving crisp violet-black crescent arc, poised crouch.

name: Void Archer
walk_cue: Hooded void ranger stalk holding obsidian bow: quiet right step, cloak sway, left step, cloak sway.
attack_cue: Raise obsidian void bow level, draw glowing purple dark-matter arrow taut, loose piercing violet arrow burst forward with dark energy trail, lower bow recovery.

name: Dark Sentinel
walk_cue: Stoic obsidian-clad sentinel march holding dark tower shield & spear: steady right step, settle, left step, settle.
attack_cue: Plant dark shield firm gripping obsidian weapon, draw shield/spear back bracing torso, sharp thrusting spear & shield bash forward with glowing purple flash, lock guard.

name: Void Stalker
walk_cue: Fluid assassin stride wielding twin curved void blades: lithe right step, dip, left step, dip.
attack_cue: Cross twin void blades in combat crouch, rear back twirling both glowing purple blades, blistering twin-blade cross slash forward with bright violet-white arcs, sleek follow-through.

name: Abyss Mage
walk_cue: Mysterious hooded void mage walk clutching eldritch orb/staff: measured step right, robe drift, step left, robe drift.
attack_cue: Hold eldritch void orb inward opening rift runes, lift staff channeling dark violet singularity, project blasting void sphere forward with crisp purple ring flare, staff rest.

name: Soul Drainer
walk_cue: Eerie levitating/stepping void wraith reaching skeletal/cloaked hands forward: float-step right, bob, float-step left, bob.
attack_cue: Pull dark hood forward flaring glowing eyes, stretch clawed siphon arms back charging purple void mist, thrust hands forward firing crisp violet life-drain tether beam, recoil gather.

name: Void Reaper
walk_cue: Mythic armored void executioner stride wielding giant cosmic scythe: sweeping right step, mantle flow, left step, flow.
attack_cue: Grip giant void scythe low gathering starlight violet sheen, hoist huge scythe cleanly above armored helm, devastating wide astral scythe cleave forward with crisp neon-violet trail, cold recovery.

name: Abyssal Sorcerer
walk_cue: Grand void archmage advance with floating crown/aura rings: stately step right, levitation bob, step left, bob.
attack_cue: Cross floating staves opening black-hole sigil, raise hands roaring violet rift power, detonate concentrated cosmic void blast forward with crisp starburst wave, composed descent.

name: Void Warden
walk_cue: Towering armored void titan march gripping rune war-weapon & shield (full boots clearly visible at bottom): thunderous right stomp, shift, left stomp, shift.
attack_cue: Anchor heavy stance flaring violet void aura armor, hoist void weapon high above horned helm, slam heavy war-strike forward releasing deep purple shockwave crescent, unyielding guard.

name: Combat Bot
walk_cue: Crisp articulated mechanical biped march with piston knees and glowing optic eye: servo step right, piston bob, servo step left, piston bob.
attack_cue: Rotate torso locking shoulder servos, retract hydraulic forearm blade/fist back, snap high-velocity punch/blade strike forward with cyan energy arc, mechanical reset.

name: Assault Drone
walk_cue: Hovering triangular dual-rotor combat drone banking slightly forward with spinning blurred top rotor discs and pulsing cyan thruster jets below: glide dip, thrust rise, bank tilt, level hover.
attack_cue: Level nose locking cyan target optic forward, flare wing-mounted gun barrels charging blue plasma, recoil slightly back blasting crisp twin bright-cyan laser muzzle bolts forward, stabilize hover.

name: Shield Robot
walk_cue: Bulky titanium shield automaton heavy hydraulic step-stomp carrying broad metal barrier: stomp right, clunk settle, stomp left, settle.
attack_cue: Lock knee pistons expanding titanium shield plates, retract hydraulic arm behind shield, piston-driven shield slam bash forward with steel spark shock ring, reset shield lock.

name: Warbot
walk_cue: Heavy armored bipedal war-mech stride swinging heavy industrial arms: solid right stomp, hip shift, solid left stomp, shift.
attack_cue: Anchor heavy foot pads twisting steel torso back, charge heavy spiked gauntlet/cannon fist overhead/back, crushing mechanized haymaker slam forward with orange spark trail, hydraulic reset.

name: Plasma Robot
walk_cue: Sturdy articulated cannon-robot march cradling heavy cyan plasma arm-cannon: step right, gyro stabilize, step left, stabilize.
attack_cue: Brace legs aiming plasma arm-cannon dead right, open cooling vents charging blinding cyan plasma coil inside barrel, fire heavy glowing cyan plasma cannon blast with slight torso recoil, vent steam reset.

name: Repair Bot
walk_cue: Single-wheeled utility repair droid rolling smoothly forward carrying red toolbox & wrench-claw (wheel treads rotate crisply, chassis bobs cleanly): wheel spin tilt forward, bounce up, wheel spin level, settle.
attack_cue: Brake single wheel lifting pincer wrench arm toward forward ally, ignite bright welding spark arc between pincers, project golden-cyan nanobot repair beam pulse forward, retract claw recovery.

name: Destroyer Mech
walk_cue: Colossal twin-legged siege mech march with heavy shoulder pods & steel armor (full robotic feet cleanly visible at bottom): thunderous piston stride right, ground crouch compress, stride left, compress.
attack_cue: Lock siege stabilizer struts raising heavy claw/cannon arm, draw massive pneumatic hammer fist back blazing orange, devastating forward slam & burst flash with bright yellow-cyan shock arc, hydraulic vent.

name: Heavy Artillery Bot
walk_cue: Tracked/bipedal heavy siege cannon mech lumbering forward under dorsal artillery barrels: slow heavy stomp right, chassis creak, stomp left, settle.
attack_cue: Drop armored anchor legs leaning barrels forward, flare dorsal artillery cannon tips bright orange-cyan, thunderous siege mortar blast erupting crisp fiery muzzle explosion kicking chassis back, barrel reload slide.

name: Cybernetic Commander
walk_cue: Sleek high-rank cybernetic general mech striding confidently with holographic visor and pulse cannon: brisk right stride, cape/fin sway, left stride, sway.
attack_cue: Flare tactical holo-beacon raising pulse rifle & command blade, lock onto target charging cyan-gold muzzle core, fire precision multi-pulse energy burst with crisp command ring flash, authoritative stance.
